blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The general ledger is the central book of a company's accounting. Every transaction ends up there, sorted by account. If you want to know how much cash moved this month, you open the cash account in the ledger and read it.

In the old days, the ledger was a thick leather book. Today, it is a screen on a computer. The idea is the same: one central place where every single entry lives. So nothing gets lost, and everything can be checked.

If accounting is a language, the ledger is its library. It is organised, it is complete, and it is always ready to be searched.

items.q: What is the general ledger?
options: The central book of a company's accounting
items.why: "The general ledger is the central book of a company's accounting."

items.q: How are the transactions in the ledger organised?
items.why: "Every transaction ends up there, sorted by account."

items.q: What was the ledger in the old days?
items.why: "In the old days, the ledger was a thick leather book."

items.q: The author suggests that paper and screen are…
options: the same idea in a different form
items.why: Inferência: "The idea is the same" — muda o formato (papel ou tela), mas a ideia central não muda.

items.q: Calling the ledger a "library" suggests that it is…
items.why: Inferência: biblioteca = organizada e sempre pronta para busca ("organised… always ready to be searched").

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily mostrando o livro razão para um novo estagiário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the finance team. Let me show you the general ledger. This is where we find everything. Every transaction lives here, sorted by account.

You asked how to find all the payments from last week. It is easy. You open the ledger, you click on the right account, and you read the list. The screen shows every entry, with the date and the amount. Nothing is lost. Everything is here.

In the past, the ledger was a big leather book. Now it is just a screen. But the idea is the same. One central place for every number. When you have a question about money, you always start here.

Try it now. Open the cash account and search for last Monday. You will see every entry from that day. Take your time. The ledger is like a library, and you can search it as many times as you need.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Emily say every transaction lives?
options: In the general ledger, sorted by account
items.why: "Every transaction lives here, sorted by account."

items.q: How does the trainee find the payments from last week?
options: By opening the ledger and clicking on the right account
items.why: "You open the ledger, you click on the right account, and you read the list."

items.q: What does the screen show for each entry?
items.why: "The screen shows every entry, with the date and the amount."

items.q: Why does Emily say "you always start here"?
options: Because every money question begins with the ledger
Because the ledger is the first door in the office
items.why: Inferência: qualquer dúvida sobre dinheiro começa abrindo a conta certa no razão.

items.q: How does Emily seem to feel about teaching the trainee?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Take your time" e explica passo a passo — tom calmo e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Open the account to see all its transactions." An account is…
options: a place where transactions of one type are kept
items.why: Account = conta: onde ficam as transações de um mesmo tipo.

items.q: "Each entry shows the date and the amount." An entry is…
options: a single record of a transaction
items.why: Entry = lançamento: um registro de uma transação.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The transactions are ___ by account, so they are easy to find."
items.why: Sorted = ordenado: organizado por conta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Today the ledger is a ___ on a computer, not a paper book."
items.why: Screen = tela: hoje o razão é digital.

items.q: "You can search the ledger any time." To search means to…
items.why: To search = pesquisar: procurar algo dentro do razão.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de contabilidade. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please look up last week's payments in the ledger." To look up means to…
items.why: Look up = buscar/consultar uma informação.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's check on the cash account before lunch." To check on means to…
options: look at it to see if it is correct
items.why: Check on = verificar como algo está.

items.q: "Every payment is written down in the ledger." Written down means…
items.why: Written down = registrado por escrito.

items.q: "Don't worry, nothing gets lost in the ledger." This means…
options: everything stays and can be found
items.why: Gets lost = se perde; "nothing gets lost" = nada se perde, tudo pode ser encontrado.
